identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase I/II, Single Arm, Multi-center Study Evaluating the Safety and Efficacy of HY004 in Adult Patients With Relapsed/Refractory B-precursor Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (r/r B-ALL)

descriptionModule.detailedDescription:
This trial is a multi-center, open label, single-arm, phase I/II trial to evaluate the safety and efficacy of HY004 treatment in Adult (aged 18\~65 years old) patients with r/r B-cell ALL.

The phase I part of the trial is to evaluate the safety, optimal dose of HY004, Pharmacokinetics/Pharmacodynamics(PK/PD)and preliminary efficacy in the treatment of Adult patients with r/r B-cell ALL. The phase II part of the trial is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of HY004 in in the treatment of Adult patients with r/r B-cell ALL. The study includes screening, pre-treatment (Cell Product manufacture \& lymphodepletion), HY004 infusion, safety and efficacy follow-up, and survival follow-up. All subjects who have received HY004 infusion will be followed for up to 2 years.

keywords: Cluster of differentiation antigen 19 and/or 22(CD19 and/or 22)

primaryOutcomes.description: ORR is defined as Complete Remission (CR) and Complete Remission with Incomplete Blood Count Recovery (CRi) per NCCN classification, as determined by Independent Review Committee (IRC).

secondaryOutcomes.description: ORR is defined as Complete Remission (CR) and Complete Remission with Incomplete Blood Count Recovery (CRi) per NCCN classification.
The proportion of patients who have achieved the best response (CR or CRi) after HY004 treatment.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Overall Remission Rate (ORR) with minimal residual disease (MRD) negativity
secondaryOutcomes.description: Overall Remission Rate (ORR) with minimal residual disease (MRD) negativity as determined by IRC and Investigators; MRD negativity as determined using flow cytometry.
DOR is defined as the time between their first complete response per independent review to relapse or any death in the absence of documented relapse.
The proportion of patients who have received Allo-SCT after HY004 treatment.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: First infusion date of HY004 to data cutoff date(up to 2 years)

secondaryOutcomes.description: RFS is defined as the time from the HY004 infusion date to the date of disease relapse or death from any cause.
EFS is defined as the time from the HY004 infusion date to the date of any event, including disease progression, cessation of treatment for any reason, or death.
OS is defined as the time from the HY004 Cell Injection infusion to the date of death from any cause.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Percentage of Participants Experiencing Treatment-Emergent Adverse Events（TEAE）
secondaryOutcomes.description: Evaluate the type, frequency, severity of adverse events, and abnormal laboratory test values; Evaluate the frequency and severity of adverse events related to HY004.

otherOutcomes.measure: In vivo cellular Pharmacokinetic (PK) profile of HY004 in units of transgene copy number per genomic DNA (gDNA) amount.
otherOutcomes.description: To characterize the in vivo cellular pharmacokinetic (PK) profile (levels, persistence, trafficking) of HY004 cells in target tissues (blood, bone marrow andCerebral Spinal Fluid (CSF)if available)by quantitative polymerase chain reaction(qPCR).
otherOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 3 months(BM sample); Up to 2 years(Blood sample)

otherOutcomes.measure: In vivo cellular Pharmacokinetic (PK) profile of HY004 in units of percent of CAR-positive cells.
otherOutcomes.description: To characterize the in vivo cellular pharmacokinetic (PK) profile (levels, persistence, trafficking) of HY004 cells in target tissues (blood, bone marrow andCerebral Spinal Fluid (CSF)if available)by Flow Cytometry.
otherOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 3 months(BM sample); Up to 2 years(Blood sample)

otherOutcomes.measure: In vivo cellular pharmacodynamics (PD) profile of HY004.
otherOutcomes.description: To characterize the concentration of cytokines ,including Interleukin-6(IL-6) at least in Serum.

otherOutcomes.measure: Prevalence and incidence of humoral immunogenicity to HY004.
otherOutcomes.description: To characterize the concentration of anti-drug antibodies.
